full_prompt_en: A square, richly detailed classical oil painting shows four women gathered around a small round table in an ornamented interior. At left, a fair-haired woman in a copper-orange dress leans forward, holding a slender writing tool over papers. Her heavy draped skirt folds into deep warm shadows across the lower left. Opposite her, a dark-haired woman in red-orange cloth over a patterned green-gray sleeve looks down at a shallow bronze bowl in the center of the table. To the right, a woman in pale cream rests her chin on one hand, and another in a dark green dress leans close with her hand near her face. Their gazes converge on the table's papers and bowl rather than meeting one another. A partial additional figure is visible behind the left pair. The background is a flat wall covered in closely repeated square and linear motifs in ocher, red, green, and muted gold. A dark round tabletop and shadowed underside make a compact center beneath the brighter faces and sleeves. Warm light falls from the upper left, modeling cheeks, forearms, and rich folds while leaving the lower table and dark green fabric subdued. Flesh is smoothly blended, but cloth and wall decoration have more visible small strokes and precise patterned edges. The figures form a shallow inward-facing arc, with the tabletop as their shared focal point. Dense ornament and layered garments fill nearly every corner, yet the quiet poses and repeated downward gazes give the scene a concentrated, intimate rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节丰厚的古典油画呈现四位女子围在装饰繁密的室内小圆桌旁。左侧，金发女子穿铜橘色长裙，前倾身体，拿着纤细书写工具悬在纸页上。厚重裙褶在左下叠成深暖阴影。对面，黑发女子披红橘布料，里面露出有纹样的绿灰袖子，低头看桌中央的浅铜碗。右侧一位浅奶油色衣服女子用手托腮，另一位深绿衣女子靠近，手放在脸边。她们的目光汇向桌上纸页和碗，而非相互对视。左侧两人后面还露出一位局部人影。背景是一片平直墙面，布满赭、红、绿和低饱和金色的紧密方形及线性纹样。深色圆桌面及其阴影中的桌底，在较亮的面容与袖子下形成紧凑中心。暖光从左上落下，塑造脸颊、前臂和丰厚衣褶，让桌下与深绿布料维持低调。皮肤平顺晕染，衣料和墙饰则有更多可见的小笔触和精确纹样边缘。人物形成浅空间内向的弧形，桌面是共同焦点。密集纹饰和层叠衣服几乎填满每个角落，但安静姿势和重复向下的视线又赋予场景专注、亲密的节奏。
style_prompt_en: A classical painterly surface combines smoothly modeled pale focal areas with dense ornamental detail and heavy draped color masses. Warm copper, brick red, ocher, muted gold, and deep green dominate; small cream highlights gather near the center and upper middle. Fine repeated geometric marks establish a flat decorative rear plane, while rounded volumes and overlapping folds build a shallow foreground space. Edges are controlled and precise at profiles, hands, and patterned trim, then soften inside shadowed fabric. Directional warm light lifts upper forms and leaves the compact lower center in deeper brown-green tones. The frame is closely filled, with several angled contours converging inward around a small shared focus. Repetition in the background and varied curved folds in the foreground keep the dense composition measured rather than chaotic.
style_prompt_zh: 古典绘画表面把平顺塑形的浅色焦点、密集装饰细节和厚重垂坠色块结合。暖铜色、砖红、赭色、低饱和金色与深绿占主导；少量奶油色亮点聚在中央及上部。细密重复的几何笔形建立平直装饰背景，圆润体量与遮叠褶线则构成浅前景空间。轮廓、手部及纹样镶边处的边缘受控而精确，进入阴影衣褶后又变柔。定向暖光抬起上部形体，紧凑下部中央留在更深的褐绿色调里。画幅填得很满，多条倾斜轮廓向一处小焦点汇聚。背景重复纹样与前景变化的弧形褶线，使密集构图仍然有节制。
theme_en: Four women gathered around a table in an ornamented room
theme_zh: 四位女子围坐在纹饰繁密的室内桌旁
name: Edward Poynter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
